reviews.review:
Better then fire warrior but:

Its too short, is not brutal enough, and is full of micro-transactions. 

Furthermore, it fails to live up to the reputation of space marines. The cannon around space marines is awsome, they have: organs that filter out poision, venomous salivia, instant clotting blood, night vision, and a whole slew of overpowered awsome.  None of that was in this game.

The armor in the game was just a knock off of the halo armor. And was a pale comparison to what i expect from the more recent black libary fluff. 

The combat was not brutal enough, there was not enough blood, gore, face stomping, decapatitons. I am not joking, Part of warhammer is the violence, and if i am going to pay more the 20 dollars for a warhammer game, then i expect to see that. There is a reason why my minis have a bunch of skulls on them. 

The boss fight was just stupid. it was a let down. The story was also meh, it was more like the older fluff, they should have had aaron dembski-bowden(the guy behind the night lords novels) to write them a story. 

To put it simply, its just a money grab. Granted, warhammer fans are used to overpriced money grabs, but seriously, you are better off buying minitures with your money instead of this game.

update: Multiplayer is dead, like seriously dead.
"Missions" repeat themselves. Walk into a room / area - mass of enemies appear - kill - repeat. Creatures get randomly inside walls and cant get killed. Console savegame system is not from this day.

Very good game, a little short though :/ and absolutely begging for a sequel! Sadly we will never see one as THQ is gone... Though they said there would have been a second and third :D I would definately recommend this to 3rd person shooter fans!
Gears of War wishes it was this good.

An epic game.  Battle through legions of orcs and hordes of chaos.  I just love Warhammer (both Fantasy and 40k).  It is a dark universe filled with the desperate sense of inevitable doom.  Enter and relax.  And welcome to the desert of the real ;)...
